item.title: DeFi Lending Surges 150% to $10B as SEC and European Regulators Examine Crypto Vault Risks

p.keyfact: DeFi lending surged 150% to $10B while regulators examine crypto vault risks.
p.post: DeFi lending reportedly surged 150% to hit $10B. But the celebration might be short-lived, as SEC and European regulators have now turned their attention to examine crypto vault risks. Watch this space. #DeFi
p.reply: $10B is hard to ignore, and neither are the regulators.
p.thread:
1/ Numbers don't lie, but they do tell a story. DeFi lending reportedly surged 150% recently, climbing all the way to a massive $10B. 
2/ Growth is great, but it attracts attention. And not always the good kind. 
3/ Regulators from both the SEC and Europe have officially stepped in to examine potential crypto vault risks. 
4/ When the books get opened, the plot thickens. Let's see what the charts and regulators find next.
p.title: DeFi Lending Hits $10B Amid Regulators' Probe
